text:
Silver Price in 2013
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2013, the LBMA silver price fell 39.1% between 2013-01-31 ($32.03) and 2013-12-31 ($19.50). The highest sampled price was $32.03 in January and the lowest was $18.86 in June. The mean of these observations was $23.53. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
